concerns.text: T005 writes data_gap_summary.txt but does NOT implement the abort condition promised by plan.md Phase 0 ('abort the pipeline with exit code 1 and log No Data'). FR-001 requires downloading 'at least three public scRNA-seq datasets' but spec.md lists them as placeholders 'GSE, GSE, GSE'. T005 cannot verify coverage of FR-001 without knowing which three accessions are actually required.

T007 implements Trustworthiness and Local Continuity metrics but spec.md FR-002 defers the sampling strategy ('[deferred] randomly sampled cell pairs') and FR-003 does not define 'Local Continuity (LCA) metric' precisely. T007 cannot verify it covers FR-002/FR-003 without a concrete definition of what 'LCA' is and how many cell pairs to sample.

T008 implements PCA with n_components=30 (from T003 config), but spec.md FR-004 only says 'PCA (top principal components)' without specifying 30. T008 cannot verify coverage of FR-004 without explicit confirmation that 30 components is the required number.

T009 implements Leiden clustering with Silhouette Score optimization, but spec.md FR-005 does not explicitly state that 'resolution parameter' is the optimization variable—it only says 'number of clusters is optimized.' T009 cannot verify coverage of FR-005 without explicit confirmation that resolution sweeping is the intended method.

T011 implements conditional logic: 'If datasets_processed > 1: mixed-effects model; If datasets_processed == 1: fixed-effects ANOVA.' Spec.md FR-006 mandates 'mixed-effects model with formula fidelity ~ method + (1|dataset)' unconditionally. T011 does NOT cover FR-006 as stated; it covers a downgraded version. Either spec.md FR-006 must be updated to authorize the conditional downgrade, or T011 must be revised to always fit mixed-effects (and fail gracefully if N < 3).

T012 implements TWO sweeps: Leiden-resolution sweep (0.1–1.0) AND Silhouette-threshold sweep ({0.4, 0.5, 0.6}). Spec.md FR-007 only mentions 'sweeping the Silhouette Score optimization threshold over the set {0.4, 0.5, 0.6}.' T012 does NOT verify coverage of FR-007 alone—it implements additional analysis (Leiden-resolution sweep) not mentioned in the spec. Clarify whether both sweeps are required by FR-007 or if the Leiden-resolution sweep is a separate requirement.

T011 applies Benjamini-Hochberg correction to 'all p-values' from the statistical model. T012 performs sensitivity sweeps that may generate additional p-values (e.g., from resolution-sweep comparisons). Spec.md FR-008 requires 'apply Benjamini-Hochberg correction to all p-values derived from multiple hypothesis tests.' T011 and T012 do NOT jointly verify coverage of FR-008 without explicit documentation of which p-values are corrected and whether T012's sweep p-values are included.

T014 (main.py) calls data_gap_resolver() but does NOT document an explicit abort condition if Phase 0 fails (no datasets available). Plan.md Phase 0 states 'The pipeline will not start unless Phase 0 completes successfully' and 'If after steps 0.1–0.3 no raw counts are available for any dataset, abort the pipeline with exit code 1.' T014 does NOT verify coverage of this abort requirement.

T013 (aggregate.py) computes peak_memory_bytes and total_runtime_seconds but does NOT document the assertion logic from SC-003 and SC-004. Spec.md SC-003 requires 'if logged peak RSS > 7,000,000,000 bytes, the test fails and the pipeline exits with code 1.' T013 does NOT verify coverage of this assertion; it only logs the values. Add explicit logic to T013 to check thresholds and set exit_code = 1 if violated.

T017 verifies 'collinearity check passes (all VIF < 5) or is documented.' Spec.md SC-005 states 'the study proceeds only if VIF < 5 for all predictors, otherwise the analysis is flagged as collinear and the model is aborted.' T017 does NOT verify coverage of the abort condition—it only checks that the result is documented. Clarify whether a failed collinearity check causes exit code 1 (aborting the study) or merely flags the result.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T018 vs spec.md:FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-008
concerns.text: T018 generates paper/summary.md with 'Methods, Results, Limitations' sections. However, T018 does NOT explicitly verify that every FR and SC is covered in the summary. For example, FR-002 (Trustworthiness) and FR-003 (Local Continuity) must appear in the Methods section; FR-006 (mixed-effects model) and FR-007 (sensitivity sweep) must appear in the Results section. T018 should include a checklist or explicit mapping of FRs/SCs to summary sections.

T019 documents reproducibility and re-runs the pipeline from scratch. However, spec.md Assumptions state 'The three selected GEO datasets (GSE131907, GSE111322, GSE150728) contain sufficient cell counts (>1,000) and high-quality ground-truth cell-type annotations.' Plan.md admits 'Two required datasets lack verified sources; GSE131907 source is invalid (markers only, not raw counts).' T019 cannot verify coverage of the Assumptions without first resolving the data-gap issue documented in plan.md Phase 0. T019 should include a step that validates the Assumptions (e.g., confirms cell counts > 1,000 and ground-truth labels are present) or documents why they cannot be met.

T003 sets SAMPLE_SIZE = 5000 in config.py, but plan.md Phase 1 states 'If n_cells > 10,000, randomly sample [deferred] cells.' The word '[deferred]' appears in the plan, indicating the sample size is unresolved. T003 implements a specific choice (5000) without explicit authorization from spec.md or plan.md. Update plan.md to replace '[deferred]' with '5000 cells' or add a note that T003 resolves this deferred value.

T005 writes data/manifest.json with status 'Available' or 'Unavailable' for each accession. T006 reads the manifest and downloads only 'Available' datasets. However, T005 does not document what happens if ALL datasets are 'Unavailable'—does T006 still run and produce empty output, or does T014 check and abort? Add explicit documentation to T005 describing the failure signal (e.g., a flag file or exit code) that T014 uses to abort cleanly.

T011 applies Benjamini-Hochberg correction to model p-values. T012 performs sensitivity sweeps that may generate additional p-values. However, neither task documents whether the corrections are combined or separate. Clarify in T011 and T012 whether the FDR correction in T011 applies only to the model p-values, or also to p-values derived from the sensitivity sweep in T012 (as FR-008 requires 'all p-values derived from multiple hypothesis tests').

T015 and T016 implement unit tests on synthetic data. T017 runs the full pipeline on real data. However, the execution order section does not document whether T015 and T016 must pass before T017 is allowed to run, or whether they are independent. Clarify in the execution order whether unit tests are prerequisites for T017 or can run in parallel.

The table maps FRs/SCs to task IDs but does not include all tasks. For example, T014 (main orchestrator) is not listed, nor are T018 (reporting) and T019 (reproducibility). Extend the table to include all 19 tasks so every task is mapped to at least one FR/SC or explicitly marked as 'supporting' (e.g., T014 = orchestration, T018 = reporting).
